name: fleet-baseline-score-biases
description: First real 9-repo fleet baseline (2026-06-11): every repo's coverage sits 75-79% because ~12 criteria (the observability/app-scope block: health_checks, metrics_collection, distributed_tracing, log_scrubbing, pii_handling, profiling, deployment_observability, dast_scanning...) have no detector fleet-wide, so the coverage clamp — not repo quality — is what caps levels. Second systemic read: detectors that fingerprint named products (pino, LaunchDarkly...) false-negative on in-house zero-dep implementations (kota-memory flags/logger), see trellis-589a. Interpret fleet scores with both biases in mind until the detector gaps close.
